title: Get started
goal: A first flight: send it somewhere, change its mode and bring it home.

steps.text: Press Go to in the Cockpit tab, then click a place on the map.
steps.hint: Go to sends it to the place you clicked. A jet can't stop in the air, so it circles there.

steps.text: Choose LOITER in the Mode menu in the Cockpit tab.
Press Return to launch in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home, where it circles.

steps.text: Wait for it to circle over home.
steps.hint: Watch it on the map: it circles over the Home ring until you choose another mode.
